title: Higher Yields And Corporate Profits
gist: Gavekal's Tan Kai Xian says investors fear higher yields will erode US corporate profits and puncture the AI-capex-driven equity rally, but argues the rise in yields so far is unlikely to damage profits significantly; only a teaser is available.

insights.claim: Meta raised its 2026 capital expenditure guidance after beating Q3 estimates and Zuckerberg said its AI investments 'are paying off', offering equity investors a morsel of optimism.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Hyperscaler capex guidance raises keep supporting the AI infrastructure trade.
insights.locator: raised guidance for total 2026 capital expenditure

insights.claim: Indebted AI names such as neocloud CoreWeave sold off sharply, leaving investors jittery that higher yields could hit US profits and trigger a broad sell-off given equity performance depends heavily on the AI capex boom.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Leveraged AI infrastructure is the weak link where rising yields show up first.
insights.locator: after a sharp sell-off in the shares of indebted AI names

insights.claim: Gavekal argues there are several good reasons to believe the rise in yields so far is unlikely to inflict significant damage on US corporate profits.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Contrarian to the prevailing jitters: the yield rise is not yet a profits threat, though the reasons are paywalled.
insights.locator: there are several good reasons to believe
